requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: #hero -- the living map: every active home as a point on Central Oregon, every town/community/neighborhood a touchable silhouette, type toggles, a price scrubber, a card with the place's live count and median. The H1 (D11 lock) and the search sit in its head. Replaces the photo Stage (Matt 2026-09-01: the opening must be the data itself).

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: #doors -- the three routes (Buying / Selling / Investing), each with a live fact from the destination page's own source. Matt 2026-09-01: the homepage MUST route the three intents, implemented as a quiet band, not the killed 2026-08-16 button bar.

requiredComponents.name: HomeHeroSearch
requiredComponents.section: city / community / address search in the Atlas head

requiredComponents.name: HomeHomesField
requiredComponents.section: The route-local Field wrapper: V3Field with PlaceFieldMap in the map slot when map="google" (shipped default on / and /buy), type chips only (one scrolling row), listFlow, See all. Towns are Ledger doors, not a second Field chip row. V3Field and PlaceFieldMap are imported by THIS component, not the route file, so this entry is the one the import gate binds on. The Google map stays in the Field frame until Matt retires it on this route. map="none" is a named variant, not the default.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: the market question, leftover KPI row, year overlay

requiredComponents.name: SellCapture
requiredComponents.section: #sell -- the seller sheet, directly after the market verdict

purpose._: Locked v3 homepage. Atlas, then the three intent doors, then Field. Chart Room mid-page.
purpose.job: Turn someone who typed a money query into a search they can act on. The visitor arrived wanting to look at houses. The living atlas is the first screen. Search is the Atlas action. Doors route buy / sell / invest. Homes are the photographed set under that.
purpose.primaryAction: Search city, community, or address. See all is the secondary door into regional browse.
purpose.audience: A buyer or looker at the top of the funnel who does not yet know the towns. A seller can take the valuation door or the sheet after the market verdict.
questionsItMustAnswer: What is for sale here right now, and what does it cost?
Where is here, and what do the towns cost?
Is this a good time to buy or sell?

alsoWins: homes for sale bend redmond sisters sunriver
searchIntent.whyThisPageCanWin: It publishes live inventory, per-town medians and a traced market verdict on one crawlable page, and the first screen is a working map of the region with search in the head.
searchIntent.whatItOwesSEO: One H1 carrying the head term. Town names as real links with real figures. The market answer in text. JSON-LD that matches the visible figures.

dataAvailable: live active listings with photo, price, address, beds/baths/sqft, lat/lng
per-town active count and median list price
the leftover market row for the regional active count and Chart Room figures
resort and master-planned community counts, with area-guide posters when a clip exists
Google reviews, the three brokers, the living atlas of the region
notThisPagesJob: Being the full market report. /housing-market owns the full figure set; the homepage owes the answer and a door.
Being the about page. /about and /team own the brokerage story.
Hosting listing alerts. The seller sheet is the on-page ask. Alerts live on search pages and /invest.

variants._: Named treatments below the atlas. Shipped default keeps Google and keeps #doors. Matt picks; losers delete in the pick commit. Do not merge doors into the atlas dock without that pick.
variants.field-google: SHIPPED. HomeHomesField map="google" (HOME_FIELD_MAP). PlaceFieldMap in the Field slot. /buy uses the same default.
variants.field-none: NAMED, not the / default. map="none" omits the slot; V3Field uses photographed homes. Prop exists so the pick is a one-line change.
variants.field-atlas-bind: NOT BUILT. List hover lights atlas dots, then retire Google. Needs V3Atlas internals (heat-deletion agent owns those).
variants.doors-band: SHIPPED. V3Doors #doors, quiet three-intent band. Parity blocking.
variants.doors-in-dock: NOT BUILT. Merge the three routes into the atlas head. Needs a variants sheet pick; do not ship as a silent fold.

openDefects._: Atlas is the opening. Below it, the page still restates the region as doors plus a Google raster of the same homes. Retiring PlaceFieldMap on / is Matt's open call.
items: OPEN: two maps of Central Oregon — living atlas, then Google PlaceFieldMap in #homes. Named variant field-none is wired, not shipped.
OPEN: three text doors under the atlas. Quiet band is required; merging into the atlas dock is not decided.
RESOLVED (receipt language): photo Stage as the opening, Quiet testimonials, Alerts capture as the homepage ask. Live page is Atlas, Proof, seller sheet.
RESOLVED: phone-first one-off Field cards and Ledger overrides removed. Barrel Field and Ledger again.
RESOLVED: overlapping rail. V3Field listFlow keeps the list in document flow; See all is the Field action.
RESOLVED: Chart Room is mid-page V3Instrument, not the first fold.

competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow and Redfin on LOCAL TRUTH: live Central Oregon inventory as a living atlas of the region, per-town medians, and the buyer-or-seller answer with its trace. Search is the Atlas action, not a photo over a search box.
sectionOrder: V3Atlas #hero -- the living map, H1, HomeHeroSearch
V3Doors #doors -- Buying / Selling / Investing, one live fact each
HomeHomesField -- the houses and the map in one frame, type chips, listFlow, See all
V3Ledger #towns -- each town's active count and median list price
V3Instrument #market -- the buyer-or-seller ANSWER with its trace and stamp, and a door to the full report
section #sell -- the seller ask, directly after the market verdict speaks to sellers (Matt 2026-09-01: moved up from last)
